newsitem.title: USA: Torotel expects profit in FY98.
newsitem.headline: Torotel expects profit in FY98.

text.p: Torotel Inc, an electronics component supplier, said Wednesday it expected to see higher sales and post a profit in fiscal 1998, after posting a loss for the fiscal year ended April 30.
"As a result of stronger performance at both subsidiaries, Torotel expects to see higher sales and report a profit in fiscal 1998," chief operating officer Christian hughes said in a news release.
The company Thursday reported a net loss of $1.2 million, or $0.42 a share on sales of $14.7 million for the fiscal year ended April 30.

The loss included special charges of nearly $1.6 million for effects of an accounting change, a terminated deal, restructuring and legal fees and penalties after failing to perform certain thermal shock tests on items sold to the U.S. Department of Defense, Torotel said.

The company, which entered a voluntary disclosure program with the Department of Defense, said it does not appear that it will record any significant charges related to that matter during fiscal 1998.
Torotel shares were up 2/16 at 15/16 Wednesday.
